Brothers, if you’ve been in the crypto market for more than 2 years, you should all know that the essence of trading is a battle between the market and your own impulses.
In the past, I always thought that not being able to make money meant I lacked a set of “holy grail” methods. In the end, I realized that what truly wrecks an account is having no rules and just messing around.

The core lesson from 10 years of trading pitfalls #ETH 
I’ve been in the market for 10 years. The path from 10,000 to 100,000—my biggest loss was trusting the “me right now” too much:
When the price rises, I’d be convinced it can keep going higher. I’d blindly chase high-priced orders—while floating losses piled up, I’d think, “I’ll average down and lower the cost.” The more I averaged down, the heavier the position got. Just after I made a bit of profit, I’d assume the next trade could replicate the same gains. I opened positions frequently.
I put a “tightening spell” on my trading impulses #zec 

Later, I completely cut out the extra room for me to act impulsively, and locked my urges down with rules:
Manage the principal by splitting it. Only keep a small portion as trading capital. In the beginning, only trade low-risk spot. Put leverage trades aside until the trading system is mature. Also, predefine the number of averaging-down attempts—once those times are used up, even if you’re still in floating loss, you absolutely don’t add more. When your profit reaches the preset target, withdraw a portion immediately to secure gains. Strictly limit how often you monitor the market and place orders. No more staring at charts for ten-plus hours, afraid of missing opportunities #pumpbtc 

After doing it for a long time, I finally understood: the most dangerous thing in the market is never that you don’t have opportunities, but that you mistakenly believe every fluctuation is a chance to make money. Long-term stable profitability has never depended on being right with a big bet on a single occasion. More often, it’s because when you want to rush in, you manage to hold back; when you want to average down, you stop; and when you make money, you take profits in time. In the end, trading isn’t really competing with the market—it’s a long practice of spending time battling your own impulses. Full-time crypto trading, contracts养家 @Square-Creator-e6126298997b7

I hear a lot of people saying that $UNI  has really been grinding people down recently.
Every day it just hovers around the 9-dollar mark—can’t really move up, and when it drops it doesn’t fall deep.
Most people seeing this kind of trend probably start getting annoyed: 
“Is UNI done for?”

But I actually think this stage is the easiest time to shake people out.
Look at the trading volume before—then you’ll understand.
When $UNI  surged on September 23, the single-day trading volume briefly exceeded $1.4 billion. After that, as the price pulled back, the volume clearly cooled off too.

This is actually pretty normal.
The people who chased in earlier are rotating their positions; short-term capital is withdrawing, and the market begins to find a new balance.
What’s truly worth watching, though, is whether around the $9 level there’s ongoing panic selling.
From what I’m seeing right now, it feels more like this: it can’t go up, but nobody seems willing to dump aggressively.

This kind of market is definitely boring.
But it’s also often the place where people regret it the most.
And don’t forget: CME plans to launch UNI futures on October 19, and it’s still pending regulatory review.
So my stance on UNI is simple right now: I’m not worried about going sideways—I’d rather add more if it drops.

Because real big moves never come with a notice telling you in advance:
“Brothers, I’m starting the pump tomorrow.”
It usually happens right when everyone thinks it’s boring and has no point—then suddenly volume spikes.

And by then, if UNI breaks through the previous high again, you’ll probably see another wave of people come out asking:
“Can $UNI  still be chased?”
I’d rather think through the position and the logic before nobody’s talking about it.
The longer it grinds around $9, the more I want to know which direction it’s ultimately preparing to move.
Don’t wait until it starts moving—you only begin to FOMO.👀

听到很多人说，$UNI 最近是真的磨人。
每天就在9刀附近晃来晃去，涨也涨不动，跌也跌不深。
大多数人看到这种走势估计已经开始烦了：
“UNI是不是没戏了？”

但我反而觉得，现在这个阶段是最容易把人洗出去的。
你去看一下前面的成交量就知道了。
9月23日$UNI 冲的时候，单日成交量一度超过14亿美元，后面随着价格回落，成交量也明显降了下来。

这其实很正常。
前面追进去的人在换手，短线资金退潮，市场开始重新找平衡。
真正值得看的，反而是9刀附近到底有没有持续出现恐慌性抛售。
目前我看到的感觉更像是：涨不动，但也没人愿意疯狂砸。

这种盘面确实最无聊。
但也往往是最容易让人后悔的位置。
而且别忘了，CME计划10月19日推出UNI期货，目前仍待监管审查。
所以我现在对UNI的态度很简单：横盘我不慌，跌下来我更想加仓。

因为真正的大行情从来不会提前告诉你：
“兄弟们，我明天开始拉盘了。”
它往往就是在所有人觉得无聊、觉得没意思的时候，突然放量。

到时候如果UNI重新突破前高，估计又会有一群人跑出来问：
“$UNI 还能不能追？”
我反而更想在没人讨论的时候，把位置和逻辑先想清楚。
9刀附近磨得越久，我越想看看它最后到底准备往哪边走。

以太坊ETH市场深度分析：杠杆ETP获批后的机遇与挑战

一、价格走势回顾

北京时间2026年10月5日凌晨，以太坊报价2702美元，过去24小时内最高触及2738美元，涨幅约0.89%。从小时K线来看，ETH在触及2733美元布林带上轨附近后遭遇明显阻力，随后连续四根小时阴线将价格从2731美元拉低至2698美元，目前在2700美元整数关口附近企稳。现货交易量方面，最近一小时成交量约3027万美元，较前一小时有所萎缩，显示市场在关键位置观望情绪浓厚。本轮行情的主要催化剂是SEC批准了首批以太坊杠杆ETP产品，包括三倍做多和三倍做空的以太坊期货ETF，这为传统投资者提供了更丰富的风险敞口工具。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统显示，当前价格已跌破7周期均线2719美元，但仍维持在25周期均线2707美元和99周期均线2699美元上方，三线呈多头排列但间距收窄，暗示上行动能正在减弱。布林带方面，上轨2733美元恰好是本轮高点位置，中轨2709美元，下轨2684美元，价格从上轨回落至中轨附近，短期波动区间收窄至约50美元。

MACD指标出现高位死叉迹象，DIFF线从9.08回落至5.27，DEA线维持在6.44附近，MACD柱状图由正转负至负1.17，虽然空头信号尚不强烈，但动能衰减趋势明确。RSI指标快速降温，6周期RSI从74.0回落至35.5，12周期RSI从71.6回落至45.6，已经接近中性区域，说明短期超买状态已基本释放。KDJ指标方面，K值降至34.1，D值降至51.7，J值跌至负1.27，接近超卖区域，短线可能出现技术性反弹。

抛物线SAR指标翻转至2738美元位于价格上方，形成短期空头信号。SuperTrend指标维持在2701美元，当前价格刚好位于其上方，这是关键的多空分界线。如果价格有效跌破2700美元SuperTrend支撑，可能触发更大级别的回调。ATR指标显示14周期平均真实波幅为10.85美元，波动率处于正常水平，未出现极端波动。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多空因素交织的复杂局面。从利好因素来看，SEC批准杠杆ETP产品是重要的制度性利好，标志着监管机构对以太坊衍生品的认可程度进一步提升。质押数据方面，当前质押入口队列有151万枚ETH等待进入，总质押量约4370万枚，庞大的质押规模为流通供应提供了有效缓冲。链上活动方面，Raydium等DeFi协议的DEX交易量从八月份的5亿美元飙升至九月份的28亿美元，显示生态活跃度显著提升。

然而风险因素同样不容忽视。验证者退出队列出现激增，多日积压达到约85万枚ETH，这些退出验证者的ETH可能转化为现货卖压。美国现货以太坊ETF过去一周净流出1.38亿美元，显示传统金融投资者的需求相对疲弱。技术面上，价格从布林带上轨2733美元被精确打回，与比特币类似的冲高回落形态暗示市场整体短线动能趋于一致。

综合来看，以太坊在2700美元附近面临关键抉择。若SuperTrend支撑2701美元能够守住，价格有望在2680美元至2730美元区间整理后再度上攻。若有效跌破2680美元布林带下轨，则可能下探2650美元区域。上方阻力关注2720美元7周期均线和2733美元布林带上轨。建议投资者关注验证者退出队列的变化以及ETF资金流向数据，这两个指标将直接影响短期价格走向。

💼💼💼 Macro & Geopolitics Board: "Pretext" to legitimize the price route

​Financial markets never move randomly; news is the tool Market Makers (MM) use to legitimize liquidity sweeps:
​Monetary Policy & Inflation: Expectations that the Fed will keep easing rates after weaker employment data. When the market consensus is that "cheap money is about to return," retail will tend to go All-in Long with high leverage.

​Geopolitical tensions: Escalating instability in the Middle East or military/trade deterrence moves are always used as an "FUD trigger" to create sudden red candles (flash crashes) to shake out weak-hand positions.

​"Uptober" trap psychology: October, historically, is always a strong growth month for Crypto (Uptober). MM knows the crowd is waiting to buy and expects a Q4 breakout—creating the most favorable conditions to set a liquidity trap.

​Thị trường tài chính không bao giờ di chuyển ngẫu nhiên; tin tức chính là công cụ để Market Maker (MM) hợp thức hóa việc quét thanh khoản:
​Chính sách tiền tệ & Lạm phát: Kỳ vọng Fed tiếp tục nới lỏng lãi suất sau số liệu việc làm suy yếu. Khi thị trường đồng thuận rằng "tiền rẻ sắp quay lại", retail sẽ có xu hướng All-in Long đòn bẩy cao.

​Căng thẳng địa chính trị: Bất ổn leo thang tại Trung Đông hoặc các động thái răn đe quân sự/thương mại luôn được dùng làm "ngòi nổ FUD" để tạo các cây nến đỏ giật chớp nhoáng (flash crash) nhằm rũ bỏ các vị thế yếu tay.

​Tâm lý bẫy "Uptober": Tháng 10 theo lịch sử luôn là tháng tăng trưởng mạnh của Crypto (Uptober). MM thừa biết đám đông đang canh me mua vào và kỳ vọng Q4 bùng nổ, tạo điều kiện thuận lợi nhất để giăng bẫy thanh khoản.

You dare call a reversal just because it’s up 0.86%? Pass 85976 first.

It’s up 0.858%, and the comments are already spamming “the bull returns and speedily goes back.” Wake up. BTC is at 85,500 now, and it hasn’t even managed to hold above the daily pivot of 85,976—so what are you excited about?

Let’s lay out the facts first. In the past 24 hours, the low was 84,772 and the high was 86,976. Right now at 85,500, it’s lying on the lower half of the trading range. Turnover is 8.52 billion USDT—not exactly quiet, but also hardly “hyped.” This is a rebound, not a reversal.

The real highlight is the funding rate: 0.0072%. What does that mean? Bulls don’t even have the desire to add leverage. Up 0.8% and this is the posture—caution is baked into the mindset. On the other hand, nobody is squeezing into the long side either. If it really wants to move up, the load is light. A行情 (market move) that retail traders are afraid to chase often turns out to be the one with a real chance.

ETH is even more disappointing. At 2,701, its gain is only 0.367%—you can’t even see the tail light of BTC. The 24-hour high at 2,738 only touched briefly and then retreated. The daily sell point at 2,747 is right there in front, and nobody dares to touch it. Funds are stuck in BTC—season for altcoins? First ask whether ETH is willing.

Meanwhile, XRP quietly climbed 0.879%, and the price at 1.50 is stepping on the 1.49 buy point. Small coins have more punch than big ones—this picture alone is already ironic.

My stance: slightly bullish, but with conditions.

Condition one: the daily buy point at 85,183 can’t be lost. At 85,500 now, it’s less than 400 points away—your buffer is as thin as paper. Holding means you’re building energy; if it breaks down, you face the previous low at 84,772 head-on.

Condition two: to confirm strength, first reclaim the 85,976 pivot, then we can talk about the daily sell point at 87,276. If you can’t get back above the pivot, judge the “value” of the upside for yourself.

Straight talk: above 85,183, the data is biased bullish, and I stand on the long side. If it loses that level, I immediately change my tune—downside risk increases. Trading isn’t about dating—don’t develop feelings for specific price levels.

A slow grind up isn’t scary. What’s scary is if you don’t set a stop loss and keep fantasizing about getting rich overnight.

涨0.86%就敢喊反转？先过85976这关再说

涨了0.858%，评论区又开始刷“牛回速归”。醒醒，BTC现在85500，连日线轴心85976都没站上去，激动什么？

先摆事实。24小时最低84772，最高86976，现在的85500趴在箱体下半截。成交额85.2亿USDT，不冷清，也谈不上亢奋。这叫反弹，不叫反转。

真正的看点是资金费率：0.0072%。什么概念？多头连加杠杆的欲望都没有。涨了0.8%就这点姿态，情绪谨慎到骨子里。反过来说，也没人挤在多头这边——真要往上走，包袱很轻。散户不敢追的行情，往往才有戏。

ETH更拉胯。2701的价格，涨幅只有0.367%，连BTC的车尾灯都看不见。24小时高点2738摸了一下就缩回去，2747的日线卖点近在眼前，没人敢碰。资金窝在BTC里，山寨季？先问ETH答不答应。

倒是XRP不声不响涨了0.879%，1.50的价格踩在1.49的买点上。小币比大币有劲，这画面本身就够讽刺。

我的态度：偏多，但有条件。

条件一：85183的日线买点不能丢。现在85500离它不到400点，缓冲薄得像纸。守住是蓄力，跌破就直面84772的前低。

条件二：想确认强势，先收复85976轴心，再谈87276的日线卖点。收不回轴心的上涨，含金量自己掂量。

痛快话：85183上方，数据偏多，我站多头这边；失守，立刻改口下行风险加大。交易不是谈恋爱，别对点位有感情。

慢涨不可怕，可怕的是你不设止损还在幻想一夜暴富。
